sources.note: Town of Ludlow, Board of Selectmen minutes, April 6, 2026, item VI.G (under 'Appoint Non-Elected Town Officers'): motion to appoint Jeff Billings to the First Constable position, passed unanimously.

Town of Ludlow, Board of Selectmen minutes, April 6, 2026, item VI.B ('Board of Listers - non-elected (2) Positions'): motion to appoint Doug Sheehan as Lister, passed unanimously (a reappointment; his prior appointed term had expired in 2025). Only one of the two non-elected lister positions was filled at that meeting.

sources.note: Town of Ludlow, Board of Selectmen minutes, April 6, 2026, item VI.T: motion to appoint Doug Sheehan as Trustee of Public Funds, passed unanimously.

Town of Ludlow, Board of Cemetery Commissioners minutes, July 15, 2026 (confirmed identical in the minutes of September 16, 2026): 'Board Members Present: Bob Brandt, Bruce Schmidt, Scott Baitz, George Tucker, Jr.' Brandt was elected Chair at the commission's reorganization of March 18, 2026. No fetched document states the mechanism by which each holds his seat; the seating bases recorded here are the operator's disclosed adjudication (Brandt elected -- seated by the March 2026 reorganization past a printed 2025 term expiry; Baitz appointed -- continuity of his prior appointed seat; Tucker appointed -- he joined between March 18 and July 15, 2026, when no election exists, i.e. a vacancy appointment, though no selectboard appointment minute was located in the April 6, June 1, or July 6, 2026 minutes). See issue #163 sweep report.
